name: ✅Find a color or Fall❌
desc:
Game rules:
1. Run to the color that is show. ✅
2. Standing on the wrong color when the time is up? You Fall.❌
3. The last player standing in the game wins!⭐️

In the first one they can give you Gravity coils, in the next one you'll all be small, in the next one you have guns lol.
The server size is 50 people pretty fun with so many people.

In this game you can find 37 different mods

This game from "Don't leave the circle!" creators
